006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.DecimalAdapter;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDateTimeItem;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IDecimalItem;
018import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
019
020import java.math.BigDecimal;
021import java.util.List;
022
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024
025/**
026 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
027 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-seconds-from-dateTime">fn:seconds-from-dateTime</a>.
028 * function.
029 */
030public final class FnSecondsFromDateTime {
031  private static final String NAME = "seconds-from-dateTime";
032  @NonNull
033  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
034      .name(NAME)
035      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
036      .deterministic()
037      .contextIndependent()
038      .focusIndependent()
039      .argument(IArgument.builder()
040          .name("arg")
041          .type(IDateTimeItem.type())
042          .zeroOrOne()
043          .build())
044      .returnType(IDecimalItem.type())
045      .returnZeroOrOne()
046      .functionHandler(FnSecondsFromDateTime::execute)
047      .build();
048
049  private FnSecondsFromDateTime() {
050    // disable construction
051  }
052
053  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
054  @NonNull
055  private static ISequence<IDecimalItem> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
056      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
057      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
058      IItem focus) {
059    IDateTimeItem arg = FunctionUtils.asTypeOrNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true));
060    return arg == null
061        // Per spec, return empty sequence if the arg is null
062        ? ISequence.empty()
063        : ISequence.of(fnSecondsFromDateTime(arg));
064  }
065
066  /**
067   * Implements <a href=
068   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-seconds-from-dateTime">fn:seconds-from-dateTime</a>.
069   *
070   * @param arg
071   *          the meta:date-time item from which to extract the second component
072   * @return the second component from the date as a decimal item
073   */
074  @NonNull
075  public static IDecimalItem fnSecondsFromDateTime(@NonNull IDateTimeItem arg) {
076    return IDecimalItem.valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(
077        BigDecimal.valueOf(arg.getSecond())
078            .add(BigDecimal.valueOf(arg.getNano())
079                .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(1_000_000_000.0), DecimalAdapter.mathContext()))));
080  }
081}
